ownership_reason: Only the gold reads a form control's value and decides which pairs the control submits; hop 1 creates and returns the list, hop 2 hands every control to hop 3 in order, hop 3 drops controls that are not submittable or are disabled, hop 4 reads the name and drops unnamed controls - none of them reads a value. The gold's javadoc promises that any control other than a select, checkbox or radio submits its value; the value of a textarea is its text, as Element.val() computes it ('Get the value of a form element (input, textarea, etc)'), Element.val(String) sets it and Elements.val() returns it (HtmlParserTest handlesTextArea and preservesSpaceInTextArea pass), yet the gold submits the textarea's empty value attribute. The pairs leave the gold as name/value KeyVals without the control, so no caller can recover the text, and no filtering of the controls above the gold can supply it. The facade's javadoc ('the data that this form submits') and its caller FormElement.submit, which posts that data, fix the meaning of a submitted value.
